question: 13|How many countries has the gdp per capita lower than the world in 2019?
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_name) AS count_of_countries FROM global_development_indicators WHERE year = 2019 AND gdp_per_capita < (SELECT MIN(gdp_per_capita) FROM global_development_indicators WHERE year = 2019) LIMIT 50
answer: In 2019, there were no countries with a GDP per capita lower than the global average. This means that every country had a higher or at least equal GDP per capita to the world's average in that year.
